title: pvGradient
body:
## pvGradient

Full native Gradient: estimates the gradient of a point or cell array (3 components for a scalar, 9 for a vector), optionally with divergence, vorticity and Q-criterion, and adds them as arrays on the same mesh. Extra settings cover result names, boundary treatment and dimensionality for image data, which neighbouring cells contribute, the value used where no gradient can be computed, a faster approximation, and hyper-tree-grid modes. Use gradient for the common case.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Divergence, vorticity and Q-criterion need a 3-component input array.
- ParaView fills points where the gradient cannot be computed with NaN by default (ReplacementValueOption); such NaNs propagate into later integrals.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `Gradient`. Identity: `filters/Gradient`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Specify the input to the Gradient filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BoundaryMethod` | Specify how to compute the gradient on the boundaries. 'Smoothed' uses central differencing by duplicating the boundary values to compute the gradient on the boundary elements (corresponds to the old 'Gradient' filter). 'Non-Smoothed' uses forward/backward differencing with the values of a boundary element and its neighbor to compute the gradient (corresponds to the old 'Gradient Of Unstructured DataSet' filter). | `{"type":"enum","values":["Smoothed","Non-Smoothed"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Smoothed"` |
| `ComputeDivergence` | If on, the divergence of a 3-component array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeGradient` | If on, the gradient of the input array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeQCriterion` | If on, the Q-criterion of a 3-component array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ComputeVorticity` | If on, the vorticity/curl of a 3-component array is computed. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ContributingCellOption` | Specify which dimensions of cells should be used when computing gradient quantities. Default is to use the dataset maximum cell dimension. | `{"type":"enum","values":["All","Patch","Dataset Max"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"All"` |
| `Dimensionality` | Specify whether to compute the gradient in two or three dimensions. In two dimensions, the X and Y dimensions are used. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Two","Three"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Two"` |
| `DivergenceArrayName` | Provide a name for the output array containing the divergence vector. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ExtensiveComputation` | Use the extensive ratio during the Hyper Tree Grid gradient computation. This property only work in UNLIMITED mode. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FasterApproximation` | If on, the Gradient filter will provide a less accurate (but close) algorithm that performs fewer derivative calculations (and is therefore faster). The error contains some smoothing of the output data and some possible errors on the boundary. Has no effect when performing the gradient of cell data or when the input grid is not a vtkUnstructuredGrid. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `HTGMode` | Specify how to compute the gradient on a Hypertree Grid. 'Unlimited' handles the resolution change by virtually subdividing coarser cells and eventually applyging a ratio. 'Unstructured' operate like the AMR like if it was an unstructured mesh, which may give a higher weight to coarser cells. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Unlimited","Unstructured"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Unlimited"` |
| `QCriterionArrayName` | Provide a name for the output array containing the Q criterion. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ReplacementValueOption` | Specify what value to use when the gradient quantities at a point cannot be computed with the selected **ContributingCellOption**. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Zero","NaN","Data Type Min","Data Type Max"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Zero"` |
| `ResultArrayName` | Provide a name for the output array containing the gradient vectors. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ScalarArray` | Specify the name of the scalar array from which to compute the gradient. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `VorticityArrayName` | Provide a name for the output array containing the vorticity vector. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGradient",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
